# target_ct from 0x402060
target_ct = bytes([0xe7, 0xab, 0x72, 0x33, 0xc0, 0x5b, 0xc6, 0x69, 0x0d, 0xa2, 0x4b, 0xec, 0x65, 0xe0, 0x9e, 0x32, 0xa5, 0x4e, 0xef, 0x3d, 0x75, 0x44, 0x96, 0xab])

# Initial edx value (0xffffffa1 as unsigned 32-bit, but we only use lower 8 bits for XOR)
edx = 0xffffffa1

result = []
for i in range(24):
    # The comparison is: (input[i] XOR (edx & 0xff)) == target_ct[i]
    # So: input[i] = target_ct[i] XOR (edx & 0xff)
    inp_byte = target_ct[i] ^ (edx & 0xff)
    result.append(inp_byte)
    # Update edx: edx = (edx + input[i]) as 32-bit value
    edx = (edx + inp_byte) & 0xffffffff

password = bytes(result)
print(f"Password: {password}")
print(f"Password (repr): {repr(password)}")
print(f"Length: {len(password)}")

# Verify the solution
edx = 0xffffffa1
for i in range(24):
    computed = (password[i] ^ (edx & 0xff)) & 0xff
    expected = target_ct[i]
    match = "OK" if computed == expected else "FAIL"
    print(f"i={i}: input={password[i]:02x} ('{chr(password[i]) if 32 <= password[i] < 127 else '?'}'), edx&0xff={edx&0xff:02x}, xor={computed:02x}, target={expected:02x} {match}")
    edx = (edx + password[i]) & 0xffffffff
